text.4:10: Lo! Those who devour the wealth of orphans wrongfully, they do but swallow fire into their bellies, and they will be exposed to burning flame.
text.14:29: (Even to) hell? They are exposed thereto. A hapless end!
text.17:18: Whoso desireth that (life) which hasteneth away, We hasten for him therein what We will for whom We please. And afterward We have appointed for him hell; he will endure the heat thereof, condemned, rejected.
text.36:64: Burn therein this day for that ye disbelieved.
text.38:56: Hell, where they will burn, an evil resting-place.
text.52:16: Endure the heat thereof, and whether ye are patient of it or impatient of it is all one for you. Ye are only being paid for what ye used to do.
text.58:8: Hast thou not observed those who were forbidden conspiracy and afterward returned to that which they had been forbidden, and (now) conspire together for crime and wrongdoing and disobedience toward the messenger? And when they come unto thee they greet thee with a greeting wherewith Allah greeteth thee not, and say within themselves: Why should Allah punish us for what we say? Hell will suffice them; they will feel the heat thereof - a hapless journey's end!
text.82:15: They will burn therein on the Day of Judgment,
text.84:12: And be thrown to scorching fire.
text.87:12: He who will be flung to the great Fire
text.92:15: Which only the most wretched must endure,
text.111:3: He will be plunged in flaming Fire,
